positions.position: Expressed interest in accepting advance payments through the website
Raised concerns about complexity and preferred direct communication

conflicts.resolution: Stakeholders agreed to exclude online payments from the first release and use WhatsApp instead.
conflicts.topic: Online payments and advance payment collection

dimensions.justification: Clear business goals and success metrics are defined in sections 3 and 13.
Target audience (tourists from Hyderabad/Bangalore, families, smartphone users) is fully specified.
Stakeholder needs for Lakshmi, Ravi, and Meena are fully captured in sections 2.1 and 7.
Full single-page structure with 9 specific sections and their purposes is detailed in section 8.
All functional features including WhatsApp integration, sections, and map directions are specified.
Given/When/Then acceptance criteria are provided for the MUST requirements.
Content ownership and responsibilities are clearly allocated by stakeholder in section 11.
Look and feel, color palette, and calm natural coastal theme are fully described in section 10.
Mobile responsiveness, loading performance (3s), basic SEO, and accessibility are covered.
Budget ($400), deadline (5 days), handover responsibilities, and out of scope items are detailed.

out_of_scope: Online payments and payment gateway integration
Integrated room reservation and booking management
Administrative dashboards or complex content management systems
Automatic menu, room availability, or tour schedule management

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor is viewing a business section, when they click its WhatsApp button, then a WhatsApp conversation must open with the correct business number.
A relevant pre-filled greeting or enquiry message must be displayed.
The visitor must be able to send the message after the chat opens.
The functionality must work on supported mobile and desktop environments.
requirements.description: Provide a WhatsApp contact button for each business with pre-filled enquiry messages.
requirements.title: WhatsApp Contact Button

requirements.description: Support English and Telugu to accommodate tourists and local visitors (English only at launch).
requirements.title: Multilingual Support

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor opens the Homestay section, they must be able to view available room photographs, descriptions, and basic amenities.
The correct business contact information must be displayed.
Clicking the WhatsApp enquiry button must open a conversation with Lakshmi's correct business number.
A pre-filled booking enquiry message must be displayed.
The section must display correctly on desktop and mobile devices.
requirements.description: Dedicated section promoting Sea Breeze Homestay with room photos, descriptions, amenities, and WhatsApp booking enquiry.
requirements.title: Sea Breeze Homestay Section

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor opens the restaurant section, they must be able to view the menu, opening hours, location, and directions.
Menu items and timings must be clearly readable on mobile and desktop.
Clicking the directions link must open the correct restaurant location in a map application.
The WhatsApp enquiry button must open a conversation with the restaurant's correct business number.
The section must display correctly on mobile and desktop devices.
requirements.description: Dedicated section displaying restaurant menu, opening hours, location, directions, and WhatsApp enquiry.
requirements.title: Ravi's Fish Kitchen Section

acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor opens the Boat Tours section, they must be able to view both morning and sunset tour details.
Tour descriptions and timings must be clearly displayed.
Confirmed pricing must be displayed when supplied by the business owner.
Relevant safety information must be accessible before visitors contact the business.
Clicking the WhatsApp button must open a conversation with Meena's correct business number with a pre-filled boat tour enquiry message.
The section must display correctly on mobile and desktop devices.
requirements.description: Dedicated section displaying morning and sunset tour info, pricing, safety details, and WhatsApp enquiry.
requirements.title: Cove Boat Tours Section
